objective: Test whether causal R-JF-only persistence plus a hard speculative-prefix budget can identify durable R-to-E opportunities without any E-K continuation or active switching.

prefix_prospective_bound.calibration_rule: max observed prefix_wall / rodas_wall on calibration times 1.25
prefix_prospective_bound.holdout_rule: freeze calibration value; prefix is allowed only if cumulative_speculative + bound_ratio * current_rodas_wall <= delta * cumulative_committed_rodas_wall

calibration_selection: hard reject any candidate with prefix bound violation
hard reject any candidate with proposed pathwise prefix budget violation
maximize R-to-E entry recall within two accepted R steps
interpretation_limits: This node is an event/probe-economics preflight, not an E-K safety certificate.
Full E-K shadows are audit oracle work and are retained in the complete measurement ledger but excluded from proposed runtime cost because the candidate policy never performs them.
No threshold from this node authorizes active switching.
stop_conditions: any parent/source hash drift before implementation
any policy feature depends on E-K or transition oracle data
any active E-K continuation or committed state mutation
